detected_issues: after_commit did not check for the existence or type of session._changes
_changes was not cleared between transactions, leaving stale data
_changes was attached directly to global db.session (not session-safe)
Index updates lacked atomicity leading to race conditions
Event handlers were bound to a global session instead of Session-level events
Test suite lacked coverage for malformed/missing _changes and rollback scenarios
modifications: Use session.info per-class keys for per-transaction change storage
Add defensive checks and normalization for change data structure
Clear per-session change buffers after commit and after rollback
Bind events to sqlalchemy.orm.Session using event.listens_for
Use a threading.Lock (INDEX_LOCK) to make index updates atomic
Refactor tests to cover concurrent commits, malformed _changes, rollback, and isolation
